facts.claim: 阿比·布鲁克推门而出，正撞见穿着亮片衣回来的“我”；“我”坦白昨夜约会变成了留宿。
facts.quote: I had a date last night that turned into a sleepover.

facts.claim: “我”抢先告诉阿比调查有进展，且新进展对吉纳维芙非常有利。
facts.quote: there’s a recent development that’s very good for Genevieve.

facts.claim: 午餐时吉纳维芙说自己开始怀疑到底还要不要办撒灰仪式。
facts.quote: I’m beginning to wonder whether we should do a ceremony at all.

facts.claim: 吉纳维芙当众爆发，强调自己是唯一亲生骨肉，不需要任何人插手。
facts.quote: But since I’m her only actual offspring

facts.claim: 罗斯一言不发地僵立十秒，随后转身发出一声近乎嚎叫的痛哭，冲出餐厅。
facts.quote: a sob so harrowing it was closer to a scream or howl

facts.claim: 塞缪尔承认与奥斯汀·格雷戈里有过多番私情，说错在自己而不在妻子。
facts.quote: We were intimate. More than once. A lot of times.

facts.claim: 丹追问是什么让他沉默了二十年，塞缪尔只答“怯懦”，别无其他。
吉纳维芙没有眼泪也没有歇斯底里地离席，“我”反倒希望她哭出来。
facts.quote: There were no tears, no hysterics. But I found myself wishing there had been.

relations.rel: 订婚/即将结婚的伴侣，她要去机场接他
relations.quote: He had a wedding to plan with this lovely and vibrant woman
Yes, daddy dearest, everything is great

relations.rel: 曾经的私情关系（多次在酒店与家中幽会）
relations.quote: Usually we met at a hotel, but—I brought him back to our house once or twice.

relations.rel: 夫妻；他强调错不在妻子
夫妻，丹站出来握住她的手追问岳父
继母女（吉纳维芙否认罗斯更懂自己的母亲）
relations.quote: I realize you think you knew my mother better than anyone. Especially me.

numbers.claim: 塞缪尔杯里的酒显然不是第一杯
numbers.quote: not his first, by the looks of him
I had a date last night that turned into a sleepover.

numbers.claim: 罗斯把铜锣从墙边挪开约一英尺
numbers.quote: Rose had rolled it about a foot away from the wall

numbers.claim: 罗斯僵立了足足十秒才发作
numbers.quote: standing frozen like a statue for a good ten seconds

numbers.claim: 连续两晚天气都坏了事
numbers.quote: Two nights in a row, the weather’s gotten in the way.

numbers.claim: 丹追问这二十年为什么一直不说
numbers.quote: Yeah, but what about the next twenty years?

numbers.claim: 塞缪尔承认白天把奥斯汀带回家一两次
numbers.quote: but—I brought him back to our house once or twice.

numbers.claim: 获救后的头几天他一直在等别人开口
numbers.quote: those first few days after you were rescued

numbers.claim: 罗斯当时已走到门口一半
numbers.quote: Rose, who was already halfway to the door

numbers.claim: 塞缪尔前两天还穿着紧身衣装
numbers.quote: the tight-fitting ensembles he’d worn so proudly the last two days

numbers.claim: 塞缪尔凄然地望着丹与吉纳维芙两人
numbers.quote: looking at the two of them miserably

turning_point: 吉纳维芙当众拒绝为母亲办撒灰仪式并痛斥罗斯与父亲，逼出塞缪尔的坦白——真正引来奥斯汀·格雷戈里的是他自己，而非母亲谢丽尔，家庭维系二十年的谎言就此崩塌。
notes: 第151行“It was my fault…”同段含多处省略与破折号，取句仍为原文连续子串；事实1中“我”为叙述者（未在本章给出姓名）。facts 末条指吉纳维芙离席时“没有眼泪”，叙述者希望她哭出来。
